name: sellbed
label: Would you rather sell bedroom furniture

questions.text:
I'd like you to imagine that you want to sell each of the following items. Would you rather sell these items to someone with whom you have had some family or social relationship, or to a buyer with whom you had no prior personal contact? Please tell me the number that best represents your feeling with respect to each of the sales listed. 
A. Bedroom furniture.
